note: Corps of Engineers campground on a wooded point on the Kings River Arm of Table Rock Lake, south of Shell Knob, with the Kings River Marina, a boat ramp and a swim beach in the same recreation area. A row of electric sites on the west side sits on an open slope above a cove; the non-electric sites along the south shore are in timber. Site driveways are paved; a few are steep. --Claude
summary: Confirmed live on recreation.gov. Sites cut from 56 to 46 (51 records, 5 not available); 50 A and water confirmed; showers, flush toilets, water and dump written; fee high 23 -> 25; reservation season May 1 - Sep 14, 3-night holiday minimum, four walk-up sites. Lakefront stands (west row). 'Rough access roads' is not supported by anything read and is out of the note. Pin fine. Phone 417-858-3904.
flags: SITE COUNT: stored 56 (note prose; the facility text also says 'Viola Campground offers 56 reservable campsites'). The per-site records are 51 (numbers 10-16 do not exist), and five of those - 54, 55, 56, 57, 58, the non-electric sites in the trees east of the boat-ramp lot - are status 'Not Available' with no calendar. Written 46. Note's '~42 electric' is 37 in the records.
AMPERAGE: 27 sites at 50 A, one at 50/30, nine at 30 A (17, 18, 20, 21, 33-37). Stored 50 stands as the common case; the facility text gives no amperage, so no disagreement here.

FEES: stored high was $23. The $23 template belongs only to sites 33-37 (30 A, no water); the other 32 electric sites carry a $25 template. Sites 04 and 05 (non-electric, walk-up only) carry a template priced $28 in the rate table, which reads as a data-entry oddity (more than a 50 A site) and was left out of the range.

SEASON: reservations run May 1 - Sep 14 (2027 calendar; rate table 'Peak Season' same dates) - the note's 'Apr-Sep' was wrong. April, October and the winter carry no calendar status and no off-season rate, so whether the park is open first-come outside the season is unread; the stored season (year_round false, no dates) is left as it is.
MINIMUM STAY: facility rule minHolidayWeekendStay 3 (written); minWeekendStay 0, so no ordinary-weekend minimum.
WALK-UP SITES: 04, 05, 20, 21 - 'This site is for Walk-up only; we should not be making any advanced reservations. First-come First-Served' (fcfs some_sites).

ROUGH ACCESS ROADS: nothing read supports it. Directions are 'From Shell Knob, Missouri, take Highway 39 south for 7 miles and turn west to campground entrance' (address 27501 Big Rock Road); no notice posts a length or grade limit; every site record has Driveway Surface 'Paved', with grade Slight on most, Moderate on 01-05, 08, 09, 17-19 and Severe on site 20 only. The caveat is dropped from the note in favour of 'a few are steep'.

WATERFRONT - LAKEFRONT STANDS: the west row (43, 45, 46, 49, 51, 52, and 39/40 further south) has pads running out onto an open, thinly treed slope 20-30 m from the cove's water line with nothing between; site 51's own record says "60' TO SHORELINE". The south-shore non-electric sites 01-05, 08 and 09 are 15-25 m from the rip-rapped bank but under timber. The interior loop (25-37) is in woods; records for 26-32 say 'SHORELINE SITE: NO, DISTANCE TO SHORELINE: 300-400'. Count on open ground within ~50 m: at least 6.

PIN: stored 36.5617,-93.5947 is the recreation.gov facility point; it falls inside the campground, about 35 m east of site 34 on the interior loop. No move (site centroid 36.56193,-93.59577, 65 m west).
PHONE (lead, not written by apply): recreation.gov lists 417-858-3904 for the facility.
Notices worth knowing: staffed booth 8-10 am and 2-6 pm; checkout 3 pm; 'One tent and one RV, or two tents are allowed per campsite'; 'All daily guests must pay a day-use fee'.
